name: zsnd_stream_request_state_wait_termination_delay
description: zSndStreamRequest::StateWaitTerminationDelay waits for group delayTerminationSec before marking a stream request finished.
known_limits: tier S verification remains open for the stream request state-machine cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a5020 validates elapsed-time accumulation, x87 comparison against group->delayTerminationSec, elapsed reset, and transition to finished state.
The native smoke verifies termination-delay ticks below the threshold do not finish the request and the threshold tick resets elapsed time while setting streamState to finished.
